summary: Kerb of a busy multi-lane Moggill Road with no parked cars and no bay.
reasons: Narrow footpath edge beside vacant lot

drivers.seclusion: Vacant lot behind the kerb, but fully open to a six-lane road; homes 41 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the traffic lane with only a footpath beside; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Heavy multi-lane arterial next to a new interchange.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped, but no cars parked and no marked parking lane.

flags: Steep overall: about 8% mean grade, 20% max
sun_shade: Open; trees only far from the kerb on the west side.

best_section.where: North kerb of Moggill Road beside the vacant lot, before the junction
